llm_response.reason: The website claims to be an official online boutique for fashion but presents multiple scam characteristics: (1) Absence of verifiable company information or business contacts (no email, phone, address); (2) Reliance only on a generic contact form; (3) SSL certificate issues detected, a significant security concern for e-commerce; (4) Ambiguous privacy policy mentions without an actual policy; (5) No evidence of an established or legitimate business presence; (6) Mimics real brands/artists (Arte Antwerp) without verifiable affiliation. These factors combine to strongly indicate this is a fake online shopping scam designed to steal customer info and/or payments.
